scope: 89 adopted utterances; 16 opening utterances retained exactly, 73 new body utterances. All 33 new Yametaro utterances screened with ASR, VAD, RMS, and approximate word timestamps.

generationAdjustment.decision: The 1.3 s onward region contains the intended final word 全部, not disposable filler. Adopt the moderate 0.45 generation to shorten excessive duration while retaining the final question. Reject the 0.35 generation conservatively: whole-utterance ASR completed the phrase but its isolated final region could not independently confirm the word. No samples were cut.

asrLimitations: ASR orthographic variations and ambiguous recognition remain (e.g. 窓際族, dialect, Pets). Exact synthesis text and VOICEVOX phonemes were also checked for Imagegen/OpenAI/Codex Pets/OpenCV/ImageMagick. This is not subjective listening or proof of perfect pronunciation.

measuredLoudness.method: FFmpeg loudnorm input measurements, no processing applied during measurement.

mixedSpotCheck.note: Automated spot check of the final music/effects/narration mix.
